name: Metemtur Otelcilik ve Turizm Isletmeleri A.S.
summary: Metemtur Otelcilik ve Turizm Isletmeleri A.S. operates a holiday village in Bodrum Gümbet, Turkey. It is also involved in the construction and sale of Fugayaz Gündogan houses; and generation and sale of electricity through solar power plants. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
